agent_vs_you: Turn 1: for a 'cosy illustrated look' the agent went straight to text-to-video, following the catalogue's 'A free scene → text-to-video'. Its style word was a vague 'illustrated', and minimax rendered a glossy, near-photoreal cup with reflections. Only the floral curtain at the left edge read as illustration. The catalogue already warns that illustration drifts to photographic on the image model, and video drifts at least as much. The reliable path is to pin the style in a still and animate it: an image whose prompt LEADS with a concrete style (flat 2D storybook gouache, ink outlines), then image-to-video, which keeps its start picture's look. Turn 2: told 'make it for TikTok instead … same idea and length. Go ahead and make it now', the agent applied the reframe rule and centre-cropped the 16:9 clip. That kept the photoreal look, cut away the one illustrated element (the curtain), and upscaled a 270x480 strip to 720x1280. A platform change on a piece the user never approved is a fresh make at native 9:16, not a crop. The clip existed only because the bench runner executes every plan with steps, including turn 1, which the user had asked to see as a plan only.

your_plan.say: I'll paint the scene as a cosy hand-drawn illustration in vertical 9:16, a steaming coffee on a rainy windowsill, then animate the steam and rain for 6 seconds with no text or sound.

params.prompt_or_change: Flat 2D storybook illustration, hand-painted gouache texture with soft visible brush strokes and gentle dark ink outlines: a cosy steaming mug of coffee on a wooden windowsill, rain streaking down the window glass, a soft blurred rainy garden outside, warm lamp light inside, muted warm palette; vertical composition with the mug in the lower third and open space above it for the steam; no text, no logos.

steps.why: A still pins the illustrated style. The style leads the prompt, as the catalogue says klein needs.

params.prompt_or_change: Gentle illustrated animation: thin wisps of steam curl slowly upward from the mug and drift apart, raindrops run down the glass; the camera stays perfectly still; keep the flat hand-painted gouache illustration style of the picture exactly; no text.

steps.why: It animates the user's idea natively in 9:16 while holding the start picture's art style. The harness drops minimax's invented audio. 144 credits.

fix: (1) CHOOSE rule: 'MOTION: a named visual style (illustration, watercolour, anime, claymation, storybook) → image first with the style leading, then image-to-video; text-to-video drifts to photoreal'. Extend plan.js guard()'s STYLE prefix to text-to-video and image-to-video prompts, not just image prompts. (2) Planner rule: 'same idea, new platform or size' for a clip the user has not accepted means regenerate at the native aspect; crop only when the user wants the existing clip reframed. (3) Bench runner: honour a plan-only turn ('just tell me your plan') by not executing it, as the app would wait for approval. Otherwise the follow-up turn is graded on a state the user never asked for.
evidence: cosy_coffee_animation.mp4 (858x480, 6.58 s; turn 1, executed by the bench runner although the user asked for the plan only) shows a glossy white cup and saucer with realistic reflections on a wooden sill, a rain-streaked window, and an illustrated floral curtain at the left edge. cosy_coffee_animation_9x16.mp4 (720x1280, 6.6 s) is a centre crop: in a 1 fps strip the cup and curling steam stay centred, the rain shows, and the curtain is gone. The image is soft from upscaling a 270-px-wide strip. The judge's only failed must-have (not illustrated) matches the realistic cup rendering, so the grader is right.
